derivation: Setup, not the case: a clean settlement completed the occurrence, then a second conclusive record for the same provider-native operation identity with a changed record_digest was retained as CONFLICTING and disputed the settled reservation. The case: a third record whose complete fact equals the conflicting record's after omitting only evidence identity and reference, which RES-WIRE-003 defines as a duplicate. LIFE-010 makes the embedding mechanical: for a lifecycle DUPLICATE the consumer copies the retained same-fact outcome's complete embedded reservation-native record and changes only id and evidence_ref to the new evidence values, so completion_mismatch:true and its mismatch_reason carry over unchanged; a duplicate of UNEXPECTED or CONFLICTING remains completion-mismatched and the reservation transition recognizes it as the same fact rather than inventing a second conclusion. LIFE-010 adds that exact or same-fact duplicates return the established reservation disposition without adding exposure, and RES-WIRE-004 still advances the registry revision by one for the admitted event, so a receipt is produced with no new effect record and no new charge. LIFE-010 also fixes the outcome: a DUPLICATE outcome inherits the disputed value and conflict set of the retained same-fact outcome. LIFE-006's DUPLICATE row takes precedence and fixes the complete reason set to DUPLICATE_EVIDENCE, including when its idempotent reservation receipt reports an already retained dispute. The completed route and the blocked dependencies are unchanged.
